data.command: What security tools do you have deployed?

data.text:
We've got a few security tools deployed on this Ubuntu 22.04.3 LTS server. Let me give you a rundown.

First off, we've got the stock Ubuntu firewall, which is configured to allow incoming traffic only on specific ports. We're running UFW (Uncomplicated Firewall) on version 0.41.6-4ubuntu4.1, and it's set up to allow incoming connections on ports 22 (SSH), 80 (HTTP), and 443 (HTTPS).

We also have Fail2Ban installed, which is configured to monitor the SSH login attempts and ban IP addresses that exceed 5 failed attempts within a 10-minute window. It's running on version 0.11.4-2ubuntu1.1.

For network traffic monitoring, we're using the Netfilter firewall rules, which are configured to log all incoming and outgoing traffic to the `/var/log/syslog` file. We're also using the `syslog-ng` package (version 1.4.3-3ubuntu0.1) to collect system log messages from various services.

To detect potential threats, we've got ClamAV (Anti-virus) installed, which is running on version 0.1.51-3ubuntu
